ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms and details from the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- The August 21, 2020 date is correct
- Entity names (Cinemark Holdings, Inc., Cinemark USA, Inc., Barclays Bank PLC) are accurate
- The $400-460 million convertible senior notes details match the source
- The Relief Period definition (July 1, 2020 through Relief Period Termination Date) is correct
- The $100 million minimum liquidity requirement is accurate
- Investment restrictions ($100M for international subsidiaries, $15M for permitted acquisitions) are correct
- The leverage covenant waiver terms and EBITDA calculation provisions are properly represented
- The covenant reset trigger mechanisms are accurately described
- The 5-business day notification requirement is correct

The memo appropriately uses "N/A" for terms not specified in the amendment document (deal size, interest rate, etc.) rather than fabricating information. All substantive financial and legal terms are supported by the source material.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS: 
- Relief Period Termination Date definition and specific termination conditions (earliest of: compliance certificate for fiscal year ending December 31, 2021; compliance certificate for first fiscal quarter after Covenant Reset Trigger; Relief Period Termination and Compliance Certificate delivery; or Relief Period Termination Certificate delivery with no outstanding revolving extensions of credit)
- Modified EBITDA calculation methodology for leverage covenant testing periods ending December 31, 2021, March 31, 2022, and June 30, 2022 (substituting specific 2019 quarterly EBITDA figures)
- Convertible senior notes transaction details: up to $400M principal amount (or $460M with greenshoe option), due 2025, with September 18, 2020 issuance deadline
- Administrative Agent fee reimbursement requirement as condition precedent
- Governing law specification (New York State law)
- Required delivery of compliance certificates and financial statements per Sections 6.1(a), 6.1(b), and 6.2(b)(ii)(x) of base Credit Agreement
